tools.name: dns.query
tools.description: Query one record type from a DNS server (UDP, TCP fallback). Network tool: needs authorized=true.

tools.name: dns.packet_decode
tools.description: Decode a raw DNS response given as hex (offline), including compressed names.

tools.name: dns.zone_parse
tools.description: Parse zone-file text (BIND style, $ORIGIN/$TTL, parentheses) into records.

tools.name: dns.spf_analyze
tools.description: Analyze an SPF TXT record: qualifiers, +all, lookup count (limit 10), ptr, broad ip4 ranges.

tools.name: dns.dmarc_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a DMARC TXT record: policy strength, pct, subdomain policy, reporting URIs, alignment.

tools.name: dns.dkim_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a DKIM selector TXT record: key type, RSA key size, revoked key, testing flag, hash algorithms.

tools.name: dns.caa_analyze
tools.description: Analyze CAA records (e.g. '0 issue "letsencrypt.org"'): who may issue, wildcard, iodef, critical flag.

tools.name: dns.mx_analyze
tools.description: Analyze MX records ('10 mail.example.com.'): null MX, redundancy, IP-literal targets, priority ties.

tools.name: dns.ttl_analyze
tools.description: Review record TTLs for very low/high values and fast-flux-like patterns. records: [{name,type,ttl,data}].

tools.name: dns.takeover_hint
tools.description: Flag CNAMEs pointing at third-party hosting that is commonly claimable; combine with targets you know are NXDOMAIN.

tools.name: domain.validate
tools.description: Validate hostname syntax (RFC 1035/1123 limits) and return its punycode form.

tools.name: domain.split
tools.description: Split a hostname into subdomain, second-level label, suffix and registrable domain (built-in suffix subset).

tools.name: domain.idn_codec
tools.description: Convert a domain between Unicode and punycode and report scripts used.

tools.name: domain.dga_score
tools.description: Estimate whether the second-level label looks algorithmically generated (heuristic, 0-100).

tools.name: domain.typosquat_variants
tools.description: Generate likely typosquat/lookalike variants of YOUR domain for defensive monitoring (no lookups performed).

tools.name: domain.similarity
tools.description: Compare two domains: edit distance, folded-skeleton equality, same label with different TLD.

tools.name: domain.tld_profile
tools.description: Classify the TLD (country-code, generic, sponsored) and note whether it is abuse-heavy.

tools.name: domain.whois_parse
tools.description: Parse raw WHOIS text you supply: registrar, dates, nameservers, status; flag newly registered or expiring domains.

tools.name: domain.lexical_profile
tools.description: Raw lexical features of the domain label: length, digits, vowels, consonant runs, hyphens, entropy.

tools.name: domain.subdomain_extract
tools.description: Extract subdomains of a target domain from any text (logs, CT exports) and flag exposure-prone names.

tools.name: domain.disposable_check
tools.description: Check whether an email/domain belongs to a built-in list of disposable-mail providers.

tools.name: domain.risk_score
tools.description: Combine syntax, DGA, lexical, TLD and brand-lookalike checks into a 0-100 domain risk score (heuristic).

tools.name: email.address_validate
tools.description: Validate an email address (length limits, domain syntax, IDN) and flag disposable providers.

tools.name: email.header_parse
tools.description: Parse raw email headers: decoded From/To/Subject/Date, Message-ID, Return-Path, Reply-To, hop count; flag missing basics.

tools.name: email.auth_results
tools.description: Parse Authentication-Results (spf/dkim/dmarc/arc) and flag failures or missing mechanisms.

tools.name: email.received_chain
tools.description: Analyze Received headers: hops, per-hop delay, out-of-order timestamps, long delays, hop count.

tools.name: email.sender_mismatch
tools.description: Compare From, Return-Path and Reply-To domains and check display names that impersonate a brand or another address.

tools.name: email.link_analyze
tools.description: Extract links from an HTML/text email body, compare visible text with the real target, and score each URL (never visited).

tools.name: email.attachment_risk
tools.description: Rate attachment file names (and optional content types) for dangerous extensions, double extensions and macro formats.

tools.name: email.content_score
tools.description: Score email text for phishing language: urgency, credential requests, payment pressure, shouting, generic greeting (English + Indonesian).

tools.name: file.hash
tools.description: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 of a file (streamed) for lookup or integrity checks.

tools.name: file.type_detect
tools.description: Identify the real file type from magic bytes instead of trusting the extension.

tools.name: file.extension_check
tools.description: Compare the declared extension with the real type; detect double extensions, RTLO and executable disguises.

tools.name: file.entropy
tools.description: Shannon entropy of the whole file and per 4 KiB block (sampled for big files); high entropy suggests packing or encryption.

tools.name: file.strings
tools.description: Extract printable ASCII and UTF-16LE strings and report which suspicious command/API names appear.

tools.name: file.ioc_extract
tools.description: Extract indicators from a file: URLs, IPv4s, domains, emails, MD5/SHA1/SHA256 hashes and CVE IDs (optionally defanged).

tools.name: file.pe_analyze
tools.description: Parse a Windows PE header: machine, sections with entropy, ASLR/DEP/CFG flags, W+X sections, timestamp anomalies.

tools.name: file.elf_analyze
tools.description: Parse an ELF header: class, endianness, type, machine, PIE, executable stack and RELRO protections.

tools.name: file.archive_inspect
tools.description: List a ZIP/TAR archive WITHOUT extracting: zip-bomb ratio, path traversal, symlinks, encrypted entries, executables inside.

tools.name: file.document_indicators
tools.description: Count risky features in PDF, OOXML, RTF and legacy OLE documents (JavaScript, auto-open, macros, external templates, embedded objects).

tools.name: http.headers_audit
tools.description: Audit all security headers of a response (HSTS, CSP, framing, nosniff, referrer, permissions, cookies, CORS, disclosure, cache) and grade A-F.

tools.name: http.hsts_check
tools.description: Check Strict-Transport-Security max-age, includeSubDomains and preload eligibility.

tools.name: http.csp_analyze
tools.description: Analyze Content-Security-Policy for unsafe-inline/eval, wildcards and missing base-uri/object-src/frame-ancestors.

tools.name: http.framing_check
tools.description: Check clickjacking protection via X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors.

tools.name: http.content_type_check
tools.description: Check X-Content-Type-Options nosniff and Content-Type/charset.

tools.name: http.referrer_policy_check
tools.description: Evaluate the Referrer-Policy value for URL leakage.

tools.name: http.permissions_policy_check
tools.description: Check Permissions-Policy presence and over-broad feature grants.

tools.name: http.cookie_audit
tools.description: Audit every Set-Cookie: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, __Host-/__Secure- rules, lifetime.

tools.name: http.cors_check
tools.description: Check CORS headers for wildcard+credentials, null origin, reflected origin and missing Vary.

tools.name: http.disclosure_check
tools.description: Find version/technology disclosure and debug headers (Server, X-Powered-By, ...).

tools.name: http.cache_check
tools.description: Check Cache-Control for sensitive responses and cookie+public combinations.

tools.name: http.fetch
tools.description: Fetch response headers (HEAD by default) with optional bounded redirect following. Network tool: authorized=true.

tools.name: intel.ioc_classify
tools.description: Detect the type of each indicator (IPv4/IPv6/domain/URL/hash/email/CVE), accepting defanged input.

tools.name: intel.defang_refang
tools.description: Defang indicators for safe sharing (hxxp, [.]) or restore them to normal form.

tools.name: intel.feed_import
tools.description: Import a local IOC list (lines: ioc[,label[,source]]) into PHANTOM's local feed store under a name you choose.

tools.name: intel.feed_lookup
tools.description: Look up indicators in your imported feeds. A match is a fact about YOUR feed, not an independent verdict.

tools.name: intel.cvss_calc
tools.description: Compute the CVSS v3.0/v3.1 base score and severity from a vector string.

tools.name: intel.attack_map
tools.description: Map free-text observations to candidate MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs using a built-in keyword table (heuristic leads, verify manually).

tools.name: ip.classify
tools.description: Classify an IP: version, private/loopback/link-local/multicast/reserved/CGNAT/global, decode obfuscated notation.

tools.name: ip.cidr_calc
tools.description: Network math for a CIDR: network, mask, broadcast, host range, address count.

tools.name: ip.range_match
tools.description: Check which of your CIDR ranges contain an IP (most specific first).

tools.name: ip.reverse_pointer
tools.description: IP to reverse-DNS name (in-addr.arpa / ip6.arpa) and back.

tools.name: ip.prefix_lookup
tools.description: Longest-prefix match of an IP against a prefix table you supply (CSV: cidr,asn,org). Offline; no bundled data.

tools.name: ip.blocklist_match
tools.description: Match IPs against a local blocklist (one IP/CIDR per line, # comments). The result is a local-list match, not live reputation.

tools.name: net.port_map
tools.description: Map port numbers to services and rate the risk of exposing them to the Internet.

tools.name: net.tcp_probe
tools.description: TCP connect check (no payload) for up to 20 ports on a host you are authorized to test. Network tool: authorized=true.

tools.name: net.banner_parse
tools.description: Extract product/version from a service banner and flag known end-of-life branches (verify with vendor advisories).

tools.name: ip.cidr_summarize
tools.description: Collapse a list of IPs/CIDRs into the minimal set of CIDR blocks.

tools.name: net.log_ip_extract
tools.description: Extract IPs from log text, count them, rank the top talkers and classify scope.

tools.name: net.request_burst_detect
tools.description: Find IPs that exceed N requests inside a time window in access-log text (defensive anomaly detection).

tools.name: report.build
tools.description: Assemble tool results into one report (severity totals, tool list, disclaimer) and optionally save it locally.

tools.name: report.render_txt
tools.description: Render a report object as plain text.

tools.name: report.render_html
tools.description: Render a report as a self-contained dark HTML page (all values escaped, no scripts, no external resources).

tools.name: report.list
tools.description: List saved reports (newest first) with severity totals.

tools.name: report.show
tools.description: Load a saved report by ID and return it as JSON, text or HTML.

tools.name: tls.cert_parse
tools.description: Parse a PEM X.509 certificate: subject, issuer, validity, SAN, key, signature algorithm.

tools.name: tls.expiry_check
tools.description: Days until certificate expiry; flags expired, not-yet-valid and expiring-soon certificates.

tools.name: tls.hostname_match
tools.description: Check whether a hostname is covered by the certificate SAN (wildcards: one left-most label only).

tools.name: tls.sigalg_check
tools.description: Flag MD5/SHA-1 based certificate signatures.

tools.name: tls.key_strength
tools.description: Evaluate public-key type and size (RSA bits / EC curve).

tools.name: tls.chain_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a PEM bundle: leaf first, issuer-to-subject linkage, self-signed root, missing intermediates.

tools.name: tls.live_handshake
tools.description: Connect to host:port, report TLS version, cipher, verification result and certificate. Network tool: authorized=true.

tools.name: tls.protocol_policy
tools.description: Evaluate a negotiated protocol/cipher: legacy versions, CBC/RC4/3DES/NULL/EXPORT/anon, missing forward secrecy.

tools.name: tls.fingerprint
tools.description: SHA-256/SHA-1/MD5 certificate fingerprints and SPKI SHA-256 (for pinning).

tools.name: tls.lifetime_check
tools.description: Compare validity length with the 398-day public-CA limit (private CAs are exempt) and report age.

tools.name: url.normalize
tools.description: Normalize a URL: lowercase host, punycode, default ports, dot segments, percent-encoding case.

tools.name: url.parse_components
tools.description: Split a URL into scheme, userinfo, host parts, port, path, query pairs and fragment.

tools.name: url.shortener_detect
tools.description: Detect known URL-shortener hosts (destination is NOT resolved).

tools.name: url.suspicious_tld
tools.description: Flag top-level domains frequently abused in phishing (weak signal).

tools.name: url.ip_host_detect
tools.description: Detect IP-literal hosts and decimal/hex/octal obfuscated IPs and decode them.

tools.name: url.userinfo_trick
tools.description: Detect 'trusted.com@evil.com' style userinfo deception.

tools.name: url.idn_homograph
tools.description: Detect punycode, mixed-script and brand-lookalike (homograph) hostnames.

tools.name: url.brand_impersonation
tools.description: Detect brand names or one/two-edit typosquats on non-official domains (built-in brand list).

tools.name: url.keyword_score
tools.description: Count credential/urgency keywords (English and Indonesian) in host, path and query.

tools.name: url.length_entropy
tools.description: Measure URL length and hostname randomness (Shannon entropy).

tools.name: url.structure_check
tools.description: Check scheme, port, subdomain depth and hyphen patterns.

tools.name: url.redirect_params
tools.description: Find query parameters that embed another URL (open-redirect/phishing relay pattern).

tools.name: url.encoding_obfuscation
tools.description: Detect double encoding, encoded separators, control characters and backslash tricks.

tools.name: url.phishing_score
tools.description: Aggregate all URL heuristics into one 0-100 phishing-likelihood score. Heuristic only; not verified intelligence.

tools.name: url.batch_triage
tools.description: Rank a list of URLs by phishing score (max 500) so the riskiest are reviewed first.
